meta.title: TSV Steinsfurt – Join the Team!
meta.description: Football in Steinsfurt: we're looking for players aged 16 to 40. Training, team spirit, community – come to a trial session!

hero.title: Your club. Your team. Your game.
hero.subtitle: Aged 16 to 40 and keen to play football? Come along – trial sessions are possible any time.

about.title: More than just a club
about.text: For decades, TSV Steinsfurt has been home to everyone who loves football. Whether you're ambitious or just play for fun – you'll find your place here, on and off the pitch.

items.name: First team
items.vibe: Ambitious, well-drilled – and always hungry for the next win.

items.name: Second team
items.vibe: Perfect for starting out, coming back and getting match time.

items.name: Women
items.vibe: Strong team, strong bond – new faces welcome!

items.name: Under-19s
items.vibe: For everyone 16+: the perfect step up to senior football.

items.title: Structured training
items.text: Varied sessions with a plan – technique, tactics, fitness.

items.title: Great pitch & facilities
items.text: Well-kept grass, artificial turf for winter, floodlights and modern changing rooms.

items.title: Licensed coaches
items.text: Experienced coaches who help you improve individually.

items.title: Kit
items.text: Training and match kit in club colours – provided by the club.

items.title: Team events
items.text: End-of-season party, training camp, summer fest – we celebrate together.

items.title: Community
items.text: A club where people know each other – and look out for each other.

gallery.title: This is what TSV feels like

items.quote: I came for a trial session – and stayed. The lads welcomed me from day one.
items.name: Max, 24

items.quote: Coming back after a five-year break was no problem at all here.
items.name: Lena, 31

items.quote: From the under-19s to senior football – the coaches prepared me brilliantly.
items.name: Jonas, 18

training.title: Just come along
training.text: No sign-up, no stress: bring your boots and some enthusiasm – we'll take care of the rest. A quick heads-up beforehand is appreciated.
training.address: TSV Steinsfurt sports ground, 74889 Sinsheim-Steinsfurt, Germany

contact.title: Fancy it? Get in touch!
contact.text: Just message us on WhatsApp, give us a call or send an email – we'll get back to you quickly.
